note: One approximate centre per town. Used ONLY to give a town-to-town distance where a store has no address-level coordinate, so the proximity matrix can say roughly how far apart two places are instead of nothing at all. Never used for the cannibalisation score, which stays on measured distances only. Where a town contains at least one precisely located store, the centre is the mean of those stores rather than a gazetteer point.
